gap: 14px; align-items: stretch; } @media (max-width: 960px){ .cards{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } /* 卡片基础 */ .card { border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08); border-radius: var(--card-radius); box-shadow: var(--elev0); background: #fff; overflow: hidden; transition: transform .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, background .22s ease; will-change: transform, box-shadow; transform-style: preserve-3d; } .card:hover{ transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: var(--elev1); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand) 35%, rgba(0,0,0,.08)); } /* 轻微3D跟随鼠标（可选）*/ .card[data-tilt="1"]{ transition: transform .12s ease; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .card[data-tilt="1"]{ transform: none !important; } } /* 头部 */ .card__header{ padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f9fafb, #fff); } .card__title{ font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } /* 体部 */ .card__body{ padding: 14px; display: grid; gap: 10px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:999px; font-size:12px; line-height:20px; background:#eef2ff; } .tag--good{ background:#e8fff1; } .tag--warn{ background:#fff7e6; } /* 表格 */ .table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:14px; } .table th,.table td{ padding:8px 6px; border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(0,0,0,.08); text-align:left; } .small{ color:#666; font-size:12px; } /* —— 排序：与截图一致（左：赚钱效应 / 中：打板情绪 / 右：选股回溯） —— */ /* 桌面端按 order 固定顺序；移动端自然自上而下 */ .card--alpha{ order: 1; const y = today.getFullYear(), m = String(today.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'), d = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); document.getElementById('dateLabel').textContent = `${y}-${m}-${d}`; // 示例：根据值调整“温度”标签 const idx = 0.663; const heat = document.getElementById('heatTag'); heat.textContent = `温度：${idx>0.6?'强':idx>0.4?'中':'弱'}`; })(); /* 轻微 3D 跟随鼠标（幅度很小，避免晕） */ document.querySelectorAll('.card[data-tilt="1"]').forEach(card=>{ const MAX = 6; // 最大倾斜角度 let raf = null; function onMove(e){ const r = card.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width/2; const cy = r.top + r.height/2; const dx = (e.clientX - cx) / (r.width/2); const dy = (e.clientY - cy) / (r.height/2); const rx = (-dy * MAX).toFixed(2); const ry = ( dx * MAX).toFixed(2); if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ card.style.transform = `translateY(-4px) scale(1.01) rotateX(${rx}deg) rotateY(${ry}deg)`; card.style.boxShadow = '0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.14)'; }); } function reset(){ if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); card.style.transform = ''; card.style.boxShadow = ''; } card.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove); card.addEventListener('mouseleave', reset); });
